title: Normalized proper/open interchange commutes with projection
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and consider a commutative square of schemes
$$\begin{array}{ccc}A&\xrightarrow{k}&B\\ r\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\ C&\xrightarrow{i}&D\end{array}$$
with $k,i$ quasi-compact open immersions and $r,p$ proper. No Cartesian hypothesis is imposed. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, and put $P_h=Lh^*$ and $R_h=Rh_*$. Put $B_C=B\times_D C$, with projections $b:B_C\to B$, $q:B_C\to C$, and $s=(k,r):A\to B_C$. Use the clopen immersion $s$ and projection $\pi_s:F\to s_!s^{-1}F$ that is identity on $s(A)$ and zero on the complementary open. Let
$$\alpha:P_pi_!\xrightarrow{\beta}b_!P_q\xrightarrow{b_!\pi_sP_q}b_!s_!s^{-1}P_q\cong k_!P_r$$
and let $\gamma:i_!R_r\to R_pk_!$ be its proper-adjunction mate, with precisely the normalization of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. Let $\pi_h$ be the counit-defined projection maps of [def-exchange-projection] and $\delta_i,\delta_k$ the canonical open tensor isomorphisms of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. For every derived object $M$ on $A$ and $N$ on $D$,
$$\gamma_{M\otimes^L P_rP_iN}\,i_!(\pi_{r;M,P_iN})\,\delta_i
=R_p(\delta_k)\,\pi_{p;k_!M,N}\,(\gamma_M\otimes 1).$$
Both sides go from $i_!R_rM\otimes^L N$ to $R_pk_!(M\otimes^L P_rP_iN)$, using the canonical pullback identifications. The identity is natural and requires no Tor or boundedness condition on $M,N$.
The same identity holds as an equality before evaluation in the unbounded derived categories of strict semilinear coefficient systems $((A_{E,n})_T)_n$ on the pro-etale sites, with exact system pullbacks, derived system direct images, termwise open extensions, system tensor and the intrinsic system comparison $\Gamma_Q$ of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. In that version $\alpha$ is the same clopen-projection composite on the ringed diagram sites and $\gamma=\Gamma_Q$. It is an equality of system maps, not a conclusion from their evaluated equalities.

proof.text: For finite coefficients use the actual ModuleCat-valued pro-etale derived functors. Identify beta with the published inverse open base-change isomorphism. The already proved canonical Cartesian tensor square in lem-pur-co-smooth-pf-exchange-coherence gives compatibility of this factor. Normalize the clopen counit using the localized sheaf counit of lem-sf-clopen-composite-counit-normalization, and use the two adjunction triangle identities to prove the clopen projector tensor square. Use lem-sf-proper-open-pull-tensor-composition and adjoint conjugacy to identify the composite-open tensor map with delta_k. Paste these factors and transport the pullback compositors to obtain the alpha tensor square. The private lemmas properOpenBeta_tensor, properOpenClopen_tensor, properOpenTensor_factorization and tensor_square_transport implement these calculations.

proof.text: For the finite assertion apply the generic tensorSquare_mate_transfer to the alpha tensor square of Step 1. Its equality is initially written using the inverse pullback-square comparison. Postcompose with the image of the forward comparison, use naturality of the mate, and cancel theta inverse followed by theta. Identify tensorSquareProjectionMap with the published counit-defined rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap using the explicit curried/uncurried component formula. This yields precisely the forward-comparison identity stated here. No projection map or proper/open mate is inverted.

proof.text: For strict semilinear systems use the actual unbounded system functors and the ringedTensorCoherence field of the supplied Realizations record. First identify the prescribed lambda with proper exchange followed by the inverse open unit using lem-sf-system-proper-open-lambda-exchange. Compare the two asserted maps under the injective open-adjunction Hom bijection after precomposing the inverse open tensor comparison. Use projection_transpose, unit naturality, the intrinsic adjunct characterization of gamma, exchange naturality, and the ringed tensor coherence equation. The inverse open unit on k cancels the k tensor comparison; the forward and inverse square comparisons cancel. Both sides reduce to lambda inverse followed by lambda, so the original system maps agree before evaluation. This is the private system_mate_tensor_of_exchange calculation. No evaluated faithfulness or total-limit argument is used.
